# How to Get Mentioned by AI Search Engines


Last updated June 2026 · By[Chalam Vatti](https://siftly.ai/team/chalam)


**To get mentioned by AI search engines, earn citations in the trusted sources they retrieve, structure your own content for easy extraction, and build corroborated mentions across multiple credible sites.** AI engines name brands they can corroborate from several trusted sources — so getting mentioned is as much an off-site authority job as an on-page one.
